newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W.Australia Goldfields pipe delivers 1st gas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W.Australia Goldfields pipe delivers 1st gas.

text.p: Commissioning of a 1,380-kilometre gas transmission pipeline linking the gas-rich offshore fields of Western Australia with the state's eastern goldfields has advanced to the stage where the pipeline has been filled with natural gas, the pipeline's operator said on Friday.
The first shipment of gas arrived in the mining town of Kalgoorlie on Thursday, Goldfields Gas Transmission Pty Ltd said.

Commissioning of a compressor station in Ilgarari, 135km south of Newman and final testing of meter station terminals in Kalgoorlie in the next week should allow for initial deliveries to users of gas in Kalgoorlie by later this month, the company said.

The pipeline at first will transport gas exclusively to its three development partners, WMC Ltd (62.664 percent), the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (11.843 percent) and Gold Mines of Kalgoorlie Ltd (25.493 percent).
Discussions are underway with a number of exisiting gold mining operations and with proposed nickel mine projects over taking gas, the company said.
It has said the pipeline has the potential to reduce gold mining costs by around US$15.00 an ounce by enabling miners to tap into offshore Western Australia's huge reserves of natural gas.
Most miners in the goldfields region currently rely on diesel fuel or electricity for power.
